msg: Perforce open source yum repo — no new release since 2024-10-22 (Puppet 8.10). Point it at yum.voxpupuli.org.
Perforce open source apt repo — no new release since 2024-10-22 (Puppet 8.10). Point it at apt.voxpupuli.org.
Puppet release package wires the frozen Perforce repo. Install openvox8-release instead.
Package puppet-agent comes from Perforce. The OpenVox package is openvox-agent (same commands, same config paths).
Package puppetserver comes from Perforce. The OpenVox package is openvox-server.
Package puppetdb / puppetdb-termini comes from Perforce. The OpenVox packages are openvoxdb and openvoxdb-termini.
Package puppet-bolt comes from Perforce. The OpenVox task runner package is openbolt.
Perforce container image. OpenVox images are ghcr.io/openvoxproject/openvoxserver, openvoxagent and openvoxdb.
Ruby gem puppet is the Perforce build. Use the openvox gem.
Open source Puppet 7 reached end of life on 2025-04-30. Move to OpenVox 8.
Puppet Core repo — the free developer licence covers up to 25 nodes; above that Perforce requires a subscription.
This file installs OpenVox and still installs a Puppet package. Puppet and OpenVox cannot be installed on the same system.
